lead_independence.headline: Martin County animal hoarding case grows to 108 rescued animals as suspect remains free on bond
lead_independence.lead: When investigators searched 77-year-old Gail Gustino's home near Hobe Sound on July 20, they found 92 dogs and cats living in triple-digit heat with no ventilation and surrounded by inches of waste. Gustino has since been released from jail on bond, with her next court date scheduled for September. Since the initial rescue, the Humane Society of the Treasure Coast says the total number of animals recovered has climbed to 108. The shelter says every single day more animals are coming forth from the same case, with Gustino apparently having friends she dropped off animals to who have been bringing the animals to the shelter to surrender them.
